decision.title: JavaScript module budgets raised: core 2,200,000, full 4,000,000 (owner)
decision.summary: The core sxml.wasm budget rises to 2,200,000 bytes stripped and 770,000 gzipped, and the full module's to 4,000,000 and 1,400,000, so fn:transform keeps the XSLT processor in sxml-full.wasm.

body.p: on the owner's choices. Amends and .

item.p: The core sxml.wasm crept to 2,120,223 bytes stripped over 's 2,100,000 (small additions of several packets; XPath 1.0 compatibility mode, , added 9,776). The owner chose to raise the budget, not to move schema validation out of the core: 2,200,000 stripped, 770,000 gzipped.
fn:transform (packet ) links the XSLT processor into sxml-full.wasm, now 3,553,063 bytes. The owner chose to keep it there and raise the full budget to 4,000,000 stripped, 1,400,000 gzipped.
The gzipped limits keep 's ratio of 0.35.

sources.source: sxml.wasm stripped, and the growth from XPath 1.0 compatibility mode; sxml-full.wasm stripped
configured: the core budget 2,200,000 / 770,000 and the full budget 4,000,000 / 1,400,000
